labels.name: Prevention
labels.description: Monitoring quality, alerting gaps, or preventive work that improves future reliability.

labels.name: Recovered
labels.description: Customer recovery independently verified for a stated observation window. Keep evidence; reopen if impact recurs.

labels.name: Verifying recovery
labels.description: Mitigation or fix is in use; check customer outcomes and recurrence. A merged PR alone is insufficient.

labels.name: Active impact
labels.description: Customer impact confirmed in the latest evidence and recovery remains unverified. This does not imply a continuous outage.

labels.name: Investigating
labels.description: Impact, affected users, or mechanism still needs investigation. Keep a dated next action and evidence confidence in the issue.

labels.name: Reliability phase
labels.description: Operational reliability phase, separate from engineering workflow status. Select one child label per Reliability issue.

labels.name: Reliability
labels.description: Evidence-backed customer reliability cases and monitoring improvements tracked in the shared Reliability views. One issue per actionable problem, not per alert.

labels.name: model:multiple
labels.description: TlonBot issue specifically involves multiple executed or failed model routes.

labels.name: model:openrouter-free
labels.description: TlonBot audit evidence confirms the selected or effective OpenRouter free-model route.

labels.name: model:gpt-5.6-sol
labels.description: TlonBot occurrence confirmed on selected/executed model gpt-5.6-sol.

labels.name: provider:openrouter
labels.description: TlonBot occurrence confirmed on provider OpenRouter.

labels.name: model:gpt-5.6-luna
labels.description: TlonBot occurrence confirmed on selected/executed model gpt-5.6-luna.

labels.name: tlonbot-audit
